$comment: Public-safe portfolio model. Products group one or more repositories into a single portfolio entry. Only display-oriented, public-safe text is allowed here: never a private repository name, private URL, customer data, internal code name or credential. A repository_sources entry of kind 'public' must be a public repository owned by the profile owner (the generator verifies this against the GitHub API); 'private' and 'collaboration' sources are opaque labels only. The generator refuses any GitHub URL on a non-public product and any link whose hostname would reveal a private repository name.

products.tagline: AI-assisted B2B logistics marketplace that matches cargo owners with verified drivers.
products.problem: Industrial freight is still arranged over phone calls, negotiated prices and cash risk. Navlonix turns it into a marketplace: businesses post loads, verified drivers bid on an AI-computed fair price, and the platform carries the job through escrow, tracking and delivery.
products.summary: AI-assisted B2B logistics marketplace matching cargo owners with verified drivers: role-based customer, driver and admin apps, fair freight pricing, an escrow-style payment flow, live chat and tracking.
built: Role-based customer, driver and admin experiences on web and mobile
Fair base-price engine, escrow-style ledger with QR delivery confirmation and settlement preview
Real-time offers, chat and tracking; driver document verification with vision models
products.status_note: Web app deployed for preview; payment-provider and regulatory integrations are on the roadmap, the ledger, matching and tracking flows run in code.

products.tagline: Field-service operations platform for a pest-control business — from customer records to field crews, contracts and payments.

built: Typed operations API with owner, manager, team-lead, staff and customer roles and permissions
Admin panel with live command-centre dashboard, approval queue and audit logs; field mobile app for jobs, calendar, requests and payslips
Customers, service jobs and reports, contracts, quotations and payments — plus a public site with a row-level-secured customer portal

products.tagline: Autonomous multi-agent operating system that plans, executes and reviews bounded work under explicit human approval.
products.problem: Running several development projects with AI agents only makes sense if agents cannot quietly take consequential actions. This is a reusable company operating system: bounded work inside a deterministic policy engine, and everything external waits for the owner.
products.summary: Autonomous multi-agent operating system: an executive planner and engineering, research, finance, quality and security agents work inside a policy engine with human approval gates, a hash-chained audit trail, fail-closed reliability configuration and readiness gates.
built: Executive planner plus engineering, research, finance, quality and security agents with least-privilege scopes
Deterministic policy engine with action levels L0–L5: external or irreversible actions wait for human approval
Hash-chained audit trail, fail-closed reliability configuration, job queue with leases, watchdogs, readiness gates; 500+ tests
products.status_note: Scheduler and live network access stay switched off until the readiness gates pass; built for my own projects and team.
